schema.description: Resource schema for AWS::MediaLive::InputDevice. An input device is an AWS Elemental Link HD or UHD appliance registered to the account. This resource is read-only: devices are physical hardware that is claimed rather than created, and no MediaLive API deletes or deregisters one, so CloudFormation cannot own their lifecycle.

Arn.description: The unique ARN of the input device, e.g. 'arn:aws:medialive:us-west-2:123456789012:inputDevice:hd-0000aaaa1111bbbb2222cccc'.

AvailabilityZone.description: The Availability Zone associated with this input device.

ConnectionState.description: The state of the connection between the input device and AWS.

DeviceSettingsSyncState.description: Whether the device has applied the configuration MediaLive sent to it. SYNCED means it has; SYNCING means it has not yet.

DeviceUpdateStatus.description: The status of software on the input device.

Id.description: The unique ID of the input device, e.g. 'hd-0000aaaa1111bbbb2222cccc'.

MacAddress.description: The network MAC address of the input device.

MedialiveInputArns.description: The ARNs of the MediaLive inputs attached to the device. Returned only when OutputType is MEDIALIVE_INPUT.

Name.description: The name specified for the input device.

OutputType.description: The output attachment type of the input device. MEDIACONNECT_FLOW when the device is the source for a MediaConnect flow, MEDIALIVE_INPUT when it is the source for a MediaLive input, NONE when it is unattached.

SerialNumber.description: The unique serial number of the input device.

Tags.description: A collection of key-value pairs associated with the input device.

Type.description: The type of the input device.
